turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and why did Owen find out from his phone?
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
Not yet. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
You're very sharp, you know that?
Flattery isn't evidence. What do you actually have on Owen's essay?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I haven't seen any timestamp. If you have one, turn the screen.
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
